notes: Fiscal year labels in company sources refer to the year starting1April; this file records the calendar year of the following31March (e.g.companyFY2025 means fiscalYear2026).

J-GAAP through period ending2012; IFRS from period ending2013. Old years from official2018 Eleven-year Summary, newer from the workbook explicitly linked by the current official company IR highlights iframe; StockWeather hosts this company-published workbook.

Net income and equity are parent-attributable. Interest-bearing debt is the published aggregate: newest workbook includes lease liabilities from companyFY2019 and excludes PayPay Bank deposits. Do not infer comparability with older definition exclusions in2018report p.6.

Operating income is no longer presented from companyFY2020 (calendarFY2021); retained null. The previously reported calendarFY2020 operating income is retained as explicitly provided in the workbook; investment gains are not substituted for operating income.

Current workbook reflects discontinued businesses: Sprint excluded from companyFY2018 and Brightstar fromcompanyFY2019; Supercell companyFY2015 revised. Old IFRS companyFY2013 reflects IFRIC21 andcompanyFY2014 GungHo classification.

Per-share figures in the newest workbook reflect2019two-for-one andJanuary2026four-for-one stock splits; older2008–2015 per-share values are on the2018summary published basis. Share counts exclude treasury and use the published period count (not retrospectively derived).

Capital purchases are not in either eleven-year table. Investing cash flow includes acquisitions/investments and is not substituted for capex. Capex is filled instead from the consolidated cash-flow statement line 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment, and intangible assets' (per-year notes below).
